# find_pattern_in_sgraph { #mofography.analyze.find_pattern_in_sgraph }

```python
analyze.find_pattern_in_sgraph(sgraph, pattern)
```

Find subgraph isomorphisms of ``pattern`` in ``sgraph`` (element and bond_type node/edge matching).

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type   | Description                                    | Default    |
|---------|--------|------------------------------------------------|------------|
| sgraph  |        | the graph we want to search for the pattern in | _required_ |
| pattern |        | The pattern graph to be searched for           | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                                                                                     |
|--------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        |        | A list of dictionaries. Each dictionary has the node labels of the pattern as keys and the node labels of the sgraph as values. |
